kill_reason:
FALSE_GAP — the frozen-PACK format has already been given a full, well-stocked trial at ARY and it does not sell. Three independent proofs, all VERIFIED on the live DB (window 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31, data current 2026-08-30):

(1) THE FORMAT LOSES 53:1 TO THE CANTEEN. ARY runs food counters (dept 130 Menu Items; groups Chinese Items / Tandoori / Tawa Items / Sandwiches / Chatpati; counter "Ary G Canteen" = the "Gc" suffix, Rs 54.28 L/yr). The hot, cooked-to-order versions of the research's own must-have lines sell Rs 27,73,222 / 73,198 units on 352 days: Spring Rolls Rs 5,85,960 (9,766u), Steam Momos Rs 4,27,350 (8,547u), Samosa Rs 4,21,305 (28,087u), Over Loaded Pizza Rs 2,83,696, Pizza 99/- Rs 2,29,086, Fried Momos Rs 2,07,400, Softy Ice Cream Rs 1,93,630, Paneer Momos Rs 1,79,100, Aloo Parantha Rs 1,77,175, Paneer Parantha Rs 68,520. The ENTIRE packaged-frozen range (41 McCain + Pagro + Vezlay, ex-paneer) does Rs 51,904 / 533 units on 193 days. 53:1 in rupees, 137:1 in units. A resident buys a hot samosa for Rs 15 or a momo plate for Rs 50 fifty metres away; McCain Veggie Nuggets 325g is Rs 169 and needs a fryer.

(2) IT IS NOT A STOCKOUT — IT IS DEMAND. McCain: 41 active SKUs, 29 sold anything, 305 units in 12 months = 0.84 units/day for the whole range. Last purchases 2026-08-14 and 2026-06-30; 20 SKUs in stock RIGHT NOW holding 95 units = ~3.7 months of cover. Per-SKU, units ~= distinct selling days (best SKU Mccain French Fries 420Gm: 39 units on 36 separate days, 2025-09-21 to 2026-08-25) — one buyer at a time, ~13 days apart, all year. The shelf was there; the customer was not.

(3) THE STRUCTURAL REASON. ARY sold ZERO refrigerators/deep freezers and ONE microwave in 12 months across 21,479 SKUs (5 induction cooktops, 3 gas stoves). This is a hostel- and mess-fed campus; the household freezer base a frozen pack needs is not there. And the one institutional kitchen buying food through ARY (Hunger Heroes, Rs 70.59 L) cooks 100% from raw — rice, atta, loose milk, dahi, fresh onion/tomato/potato/chilli/garlic/tori/French beans — and takes exactly ONE frozen line: peas.

ALREADY_COVERED for the money lines: ice cream Rs 13,67,423 / 46,564 units / 344 days INCLUDING the "must-have" take-home formats the research flagged (Amul 750ml bricks + 1L tubs, Vadilal 700ml bricks, Vadilal Cassata — all listed, purchased 2026-08-14/08-21, in stock); paneer Rs 5,09,000; frozen peas Rs 3,09,925 institutional + Rs 5,780 retail; fresh mushroom Rs 83,959 / palak Rs 20,251 / broccoli Rs 11,170; dry soya-nutri ~Rs 92,000. The coverage diff's 50-of-51 "covered" verdicts are NOT what saves this category — 36 of them are broad junk matches on 'amul', 'frozen', 'paneer', 'potato', 'green', 'spring'. I re-derived coverage from the catalogue, not from the diff.

THE RANGE IS ALREADY 62% DEAD — adding to it reproduces the central finding's exact disease. Frozen group 128: 63 active SKUs, 29 sold, 34 DORMANT. Ice cream subgroups 517+934: 421 active, 153 sold, 268 DORMANT. Total 484 listed / 182 selling / 302 dormant = 62.4%. Five dormant SKUs are sitting on stock now: Favorita Frozen French Fry 2.5 Kg (21.1 units, never sold, no purchase record), Pagro Frozen Green Peas 5 Kg (9u, bought 2026-08-25), Mccain Frozen Smilyes 72 Gm (6u), Pagro Sweet Corn 1 Kg (4u), Mccain Air Fryer French Fries 420 Gm (3u). Nine Vezlay soya chaap/kebab/nugget/shawarma SKUs are listed with zero sales and last purchase 2023.

ONE RESEARCH LINE IS PROHIBITED, NOT MISSING: "Frozen non-vegetarian snacks and seafood". VERIFIED — zero non-veg SKUs have ever sold in 21,479; only 7 even name-match and all are non-food or mock-meat. Baru Sahib is a Kalgidhar Trust Sikh spiritual campus. Strike that line from the corpus.

WHAT IS GENUINELY ABSENT (bucket a) AND WHY IT STILL EARNS NOTHING: VERIFIED by name-probe returning zero rows — Safal, Sumeru, HyFun, Godrej Yummiez, ITC Master Chef, Kawan, iD Fresh, Wow Momo, Milky Mist, Epigamia, Tropolite do not exist anywhere in the catalogue. Also truly absent: chilled idli/dosa batter (only dry MTR/Gits mixes), puff pastry sheets, non-dairy whipping cream, frozen grated coconut/herb cubes, retail tofu block, branded frozen mushroom/broccoli/okra/spinach. Every one of them is the same format that moves 0.84 units/day, and ARY already lists the market leader (McCain, 41 SKUs) in it. Adding brand 2 and 3 to a format doing Rs 51,904/yr splits that number; it does not add to it.

THE OPPORTUNITY COST IS THE REAL ARGUMENT. Same freezer, two tenants: frozen snack packs Rs 51,904/yr at 21.3% GM (Rs 11,069), versus ice cream Rs 13,67,423 trailing-12m at 27.6% GM and running Rs 5,26,083 in Jun-Aug 2026 alone. The buyer has ALREADY made the right call here — the Amul-to-Vadilal switch completed around Jun-2026 (Jun-Aug: Vadilal Rs 4,93,820 = 94%, Amul Rs 5,983 = 1.1%) and lifted per-SKU GM from Amul's 13.9-33.5% (typically ~23%) to Vadilal's flat 30.0%. That margin gain is banked, not an opportunity. Every cubic foot given to frozen packs is taken from the one line in this category that is growing.

RECOMMENDATION: buy nothing. Cull the 302 dormant SKUs (hours of master-data work, frees freezer facings and stops the listing tail), and let ice cream have the space. Two adjacent PRICING findings surfaced that are NOT assortment and should be routed to whoever owns the institutional book: Paneer_Z sells BELOW cost (Rs 236.24 cost vs Rs 235.64 sale, -Rs 562.85 on 937.9 kg — confirmed by `ary assort leak`, bucket 1), and the paneer segment overall runs 9.1% GM on Rs 4,47,620; repricing Paneer_Z to 15% would be worth ~Rs 33,000/yr of gross margin. Separately the Hunger Heroes peas line sold 650 kg at Rs 113 against a Rs 117.93/kg cost before the Jul-2026 rise to Rs 130 fixed it forward (~Rs 3,200 one-off loss, ESTIMATED — the leak tool uses a different window-matched cost basis and did not flag it).
penetration_assumption:
There is no penetration assumption, because the honest revenue figure is zero and a zero needs no assumption — it needs the disproof, which is above. The assumption is instead stated for the number I am REFUSING to book, so the parent agent can see exactly what was rejected and on what basis:

BEST-CASE TRIAL, REJECTED. Frozen stuffed paratha is the single most defensible line in the whole 51-line demand file for this campus: it is the Punjabi staple, and ARY's own canteen proves the appetite exists (Aloo Parantha 7,087 units at Rs 25 = Rs 1,77,175; Paneer Parantha 1,713 units at Rs 40 = Rs 68,520 — both VERIFIED). If you assume 2% of ~4,700 residents (94 staff-quarter households with a fridge and a tawa) buy one Rs 120 five-pack per month, that is 94 x 120 x 12 = Rs 1,35,360/yr at the 21.3% frozen-pack GM derived live from PurchaseDetail = Rs 28,832 of gross margin — 0.18% of ARY's Rs 7.67 Cr.

I will not book that number, for three reasons, and the parent agent should not either. (a) The 2% household penetration is INVENTED — I have no count of staff quarters with a working freezer, and the only proxy I could measure points the wrong way: ARY sold 0 refrigerators and 1 microwave in 12 months. (b) It is contradicted by ARY's own trial of the identical format: 41 McCain SKUs, fully stocked today with 3.7 months of cover, produced 305 units all year. A new frozen line would have to outsell the market leader's entire range by 3.7x to hit that figure. (c) It cannibalises rather than adds — the paratha demand is already being captured hot at the canteen at a better rupee-per-square-foot, and the freezer facing would come out of ice cream, which earns 27.6-30.0% GM and is running Rs 5.26 L per quarter.

So: annual_revenue_inr = 0, and the Rs 1.35 L above is recorded as the ceiling of what an optimist could claim, not as a forecast. If the buyer insists on testing it, the correct test is a 20-pack trial of ONE stuffed-paratha SKU alongside a cull of the 34 dormant frozen SKUs — cost of the test ~Rs 2,400, and it consumes no incremental freezer space because the cull frees it first.
probe_evidence:
Every "missing" verdict was re-tested against the live catalogue before being accepted, per the standing rule in assort/vault/01-foundations/Data-Quality-Traps.md. What the probes actually returned:

TRAP CONFIRMED IN THE INPUT DIFF. frozen.json reports coverage 27.0% / commodityOnly 70.3% and calls 50 of 51 lines "covered" — but 36 of those rest on junk single-word matches: 'frozen' (14 SKUs / Rs 1,87,995 reused verbatim for 9 different lines incl. okra, spinach, tofu, puff pastry, non-veg and whipping cream), 'amul' (638 SKUs / Rs 18,36,440 reused for ice candy, kulfi, cassata, frozen yoghurt AND mozzarella), 'paneer', 'potato', 'green', 'spring', 'onion', 'soya', 'blue', 'mango', 'coconut', 'milky', 'vadilal'. Those numbers are name-search artefacts, not category coverage. I discarded the diff's states and re-derived coverage from ProductGroupID 128, SubGroupID 517/934 and direct name-probes.

PROBES THAT OVERTURNED A "MISSING"-SHAPED ASSUMPTION (i.e. ARY has it, under another name/format):
- peas/matar/sweet corn -> "Frozen Peas (Matar)_Z" filed under group Vegetable > Matar (NOT Frozen), Rs 1,77,975 / 1,575 kg; plus "Peas (Fresh Matar)_Z" filed under FRUITS > Pears, Rs 1,31,950 / 1,100 kg. Both are one institutional line: 12 sale lines, all to customer 002CM Hunger Heroes, 225 kg lots at Rs 113/kg (raised to Rs 130 on 2026-07-21), shipped from the Basement warehouse. 0EUU ran Sep-2025 to May-2026 then was superseded by 0F2B Jun-2026 onward — a master-data rename, same customer/lot/price. Retail frozen peas is Pagro 200g only: Rs 5,780 / 230 packs / Rs 1.23 per resident per year.
- momo|spring roll|nugget|samosa|tikki|kebab|cutlet|patty -> the volume is all canteen-made: Spring Rolls Rs 5,85,960, Steam Momos Rs 4,27,350, Samosa Gc Rs 4,21,305, Fried Momos Rs 2,07,400, Paneer Momos Gc Rs 1,79,100, Aloo Tikki Rs 15,640. Packaged frozen equivalents are the McCain tail at Rs 2,700-3,606 each.
- paratha|roti|naan|kulcha|chapati -> Aloo Parantha Gc Rs 1,77,175 (Tawa Items), Paneer Parantha Gc Rs 68,520 (Tandoori), Chana Kulcha Gc Rs 23,400, Tawa Roti Rs 3,750, plus Bonn/Leela/LMK bakery kulcha and pizza bases. ZERO frozen paratha packs.
- pizza|mozzarella -> Over Loaded Pizza Rs 2,83,696 and Pizza 99/- Rs 2,29,086 made fresh; packaged mozzarella is dormant (Amul Pizza Cheese 1Kg: 1 unit / Rs 711; Dairy Craft Pizza Cheese: zero).
- ice cream (via subgroup, not name — "ice cream" as a probe term is poisoned, it matches r-ICE and cold-CREAM/fairness-CREAM) -> subgroups 517+934 = 421 active SKUs, 153 sold, Rs 13,67,423. Tub/brick formats present and selling: Amul Brick Butterscotch 750 Ml Rs 3,900 (11 on hand, bought 2026-08-14), Amul Brick Strawberry 750 Ml Rs 2,640, Vadilal Cassata Slice Rs 1,500 (23 on hand), Amul 1L tubs in Cookies-n-Cream/Alphanso/Butterscotch/Vanilla/Tutti-Frutti. Only the 4L-5L party pack is dead (Cream Bell Chocolate 5 Ltr, last purchased 2023-11-03).
- mushroom|palak|spinach|broccoli|bhindi|mixed veg -> sold FRESH, not frozen: Mushroom Rs 83,959, Palak Rs 12,451 + Palak_Z Rs 7,800, Broccoli Rs 11,170. "Frozen Mixed Veg - Rm 1 Gm" exists only as a Raw Material BOM consumable for the kitchen.
- soya|chaap|nutri -> dry soya covered (Nutri 1 Kg Rs 31,920, Raja Nutri 200 Gm Rs 26,600, Nutri_L Rs 23,880, Nutrela chunks Rs 9,900+6,110+5,409+3,292). Frozen chaap absent in practice: "Veg Soya Chaap" zero sales since 2024-06-30; all 9 Vezlay SKUs zero, last purchased 2023.

PROBES THAT RETURNED A GENUINE ABSENCE (bucket a — real, but worthless in this format):
- safal|sumeru|hyfun|yummiez|master chef|kawan|id fresh|wow momo|milky mist|epigamia|tropolite -> ZERO rows. Not one of the brands the demand research is built on exists in ARY's 21,479-SKU catalogue. (Only "licious" hits, inside "Delicious Butter" / "Chocolicious" — a textbook substring false positive, excluded.)
- puff pastry|pastry sheet|whipping|whip topping|bakersville -> ZERO rows.
- grated coconut|frozen coconut|nariyal -> ZERO rows.
- tofu|tempeh|tempayy -> 2 rows, both dead canteen menu items (Tofu Soya Masala Paneer, Tofu Tikka), zero sales. No retail tofu block.
- batter|idli|dosa -> no chilled batter anywhere; only dry MTR/Gits/Haldiram mixes, and even those are near-dead (Mtr Rava Idli 200 Gm Rs 1,060 is the best seller).
- hash brown|wedge|onion ring|cheese ball|jalapeno|popper -> only Amul Happy Treats 11 Pc Hash Brown (zero, dormant) and Mccain Super Wedges 400Gm (zero, dormant). Listed-and-dead, not missing.
- chicken|mutton|fish|prawn|egg|seafood|meat -> 7 rows, ZERO sales, none of them actual non-veg food (Chings Chicken 65 Masala, "Ms Chicken Fabric", an egg-protein shampoo, 3 Vezlay mock-meats). Category prohibited on campus.

MARGINS, derived live from PurchaseDetail.ItemValue/Quantity (purchases since 2025-03-01) against SaleDetail.FinalSaleAmount/Quantity — NOT from ProductChildMaster, which Trap 4 proves is stale and biased high:
- Ice cream (packaged): Rs 11,73,793 sales / Rs 8,50,082 COGS = 27.6% GM, Rs 3,23,711. Per-SKU Vadilal is a flat 30.0% (cost 34.98 -> sells 50.00; cost 13.97 -> sells 20.00); Amul runs 13.9-33.5%, typically 20-27%.
- Frozen snack/veg packs: Rs 51,904 / Rs 40,835 = 21.3% GM, Rs 11,069. Per-SKU McCain 19.8-27.2% (French Fries 420Gm cost 87.73 -> sells 111.26 = 21.1%; Smilyes 450 Gm 117.74 -> 148.45 = 20.7%); Pagro Frozen Peas 200 Gm 19.50 -> 25.13 = 22.4%.
- Paneer (chilled): Rs 4,47,620 / Rs 4,06,747 = 9.1% GM, Rs 40,872 — with Paneer_Z below cost.
No blanket percentage was assumed anywhere in this analysis.

BASELINES (VERIFIED, live window 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31, DB current to 2026-08-30 20:30 per `ary doctor`; 1,099,889 bills lifetime): ARY total Rs 7,66,84,966 gross sale lines less Rs 17,08,858 returns = ~Rs 7.50 Cr net, 372,320 bills, 6,222 distinct SKUs sold. Frozen group 128 = Rs 5,60,560 (of which paneer Rs 5,09,000). Frozen packs ex-paneer = Rs 51,904. Ice cream = Rs 13,67,423. Frozen suppliers active: Leela Associates Rs 10.02 L / 23 bills (ice cream, to 2026-08-14), Shiv Shakti Rs 4.81 L / 16 bills (Vadilal, from 2026-05-15), Laxmi Narayan Suresh Kumar Rs 54,108 / 6 bills (McCain, to 2026-08-14) — i.e. the McCain distributor delivers about six times in eighteen months.

Traps observed: SaleHeader has no cancel flag, so returns were taken from SaleReturnDetail separately; ProductMaster.QuantityOnHand ignored in favour of Stock.Quantity for every on-hand figure; TempStockTable untouched; SaleDetail joined to SaleHeader on SerialNumber throughout; PurchaseDetail read via PurchaseCost/ItemValue with IsDeleted=0, never the sales column names.

NOT-CHECKED, stated so it is not mistaken for evidence: (a) whether ARY's deep-freezer capacity is physically constrained — I inferred a working cold chain from live purchases and non-zero on-hand, but never saw an asset register; (b) whether 0F2B "Peas (Fresh Matar)_Z" is physically frozen or fresh — a 225 kg lot at Rs 113/kg in July suggests frozen, but the name says otherwise and I could not settle it; (c) the exact resident count — I used ~4,700 from the brief, not a live source; (d) how the Trust's messes procure outside ARY, which bounds any institutional claim.
blockers: NO REAL BLOCKER TO ADDING — and that is the point. Cold chain, supplier and licence are all already in place, so nothing external is stopping ARY from stocking more frozen lines. It has stocked them, and they do not sell. VERIFIED: McCain purchased 2026-08-14 and 2026-06-30, 20 SKUs in stock now holding 95 units (~3.7 months of cover on a 305-unit/yr range); Pagro Frozen Green Peas 5 Kg purchased 2026-08-25 with 9 units on hand; Paneer purchased 2026-08-28. The constraint is demand, not capability, which is why 'add SKUs' cannot be the answer.

DEMAND SUBSTITUTION BY ARY'S OWN CANTEEN — the binding constraint. ARY competes with itself and loses 53:1: Rs 27,73,222 / 73,198 units of hot momos, spring rolls, samosa, paratha and pizza against Rs 51,904 / 533 units of the frozen packs. On a closed 450-acre campus the counter is a short walk away and roughly a third of the price (samosa Rs 15, momo plate Rs 50, pizza Rs 99 vs McCain Veggie Nuggets 325g at Rs 169, which also needs oil and a pan). No frozen SKU can be bought that changes this.

NO HOUSEHOLD FREEZER BASE. VERIFIED: zero refrigerators or deep freezers and one microwave sold in 12 months across a 21,479-SKU catalogue that does sell appliances (5 induction cooktops, 3 gas stoves, Rs 12,017 Prestige induction etc.). ARY is the only shop for ~4,700 people, so if home refrigeration were being bought at scale it would show here. Frozen retail needs a freezer at the buyer's end and the campus is hostel- and mess-fed.

ONLY ONE INSTITUTIONAL FOOD ACCOUNT, AND IT COOKS FROM RAW. Hunger Heroes (Rs 70.59 L / 12 bills) is ARY's sole food-supply account of scale and its basket is rice, atta, loose milk, dahi, paneer, oil, pulses and FRESH onion/tomato/potato/chilli/garlic/tori/French beans. It takes exactly one frozen line — peas, 225 kg lots — because shelling fresh peas is the one job worth outsourcing. Akal Academy (Rs 25.96 L) buys uniforms and textiles, not food; Akal Catering Services (Mess) buys aprons, wheatgrass and the canteen's own softy and samosa, i.e. it procures its raw food outside ARY entirely. There is no second kitchen to sell a frozen bulk line to.

SHELF AND FREEZER SPACE IS THE REAL COST, AND IT IS ALREADY MISALLOCATED. 484 active frozen/chilled SKUs, 182 selling, 302 dormant (62.4%) — 34 of 63 in Frozen, 268 of 421 in ice cream. Five dormant SKUs are physically occupying freezer space today (Favorita Frozen French Fry 2.5 Kg: 21.1 units, never sold, no purchase record at all). Any new line displaces ice cream, which earns 27.6-30.0% GM against frozen packs' 21.3% and is running Rs 5,26,083 in Jun-Aug 2026 alone.

SUPPLIER REACH FROM RAJGARH IS THIN AND UNTESTED FOR NEW BRANDS. The McCain distributor (Laxmi Narayan Suresh Kumar) delivers about six times in eighteen months, Rs 54,108 total. Safal, Sumeru, HyFun, Yummiez, ITC Master Chef, Kawan and iD Fresh have ZERO presence in the catalogue — no route into this hill location has ever been proven, and a frozen line needs an unbroken -18C chain over Himachal roads, including the monsoon closures the demand research itself cites. Establishing one for a format doing Rs 51,904/yr is not recoverable.

ONE RESEARCH LINE IS LEGALLY/RELIGIOUSLY PROHIBITED, NOT MERELY MISSING. 'Frozen non-vegetarian snacks and seafood' cannot be stocked: Baru Sahib is a Kalgidhar Trust Sikh spiritual campus and zero non-veg SKUs have ever sold in 21,479 (only 7 name-match, all non-food or mock-meat). This line should be struck from the demand corpus, not sized.

NOT A BLOCKER BUT A ROUTING NOTE: two live margin defects surfaced next door and belong to whoever owns the institutional book, not to assortment. Paneer_Z sells below cost (Rs 236.24 vs Rs 235.64, -Rs 562.85 on 937.9 kg, confirmed by `ary assort leak` bucket 1) inside a paneer segment running 9.1% GM on Rs 4,47,620; and 650 kg of Hunger Heroes peas went out at Rs 113 against a Rs 117.93/kg cost before the 2026-07-21 rise to Rs 130 fixed it forward (~Rs 3,200, ESTIMATED — the leak tool's window-matched cost basis did not flag it).
